verdict.rationale: Lindy's Credentials feature stores user-supplied keys that Lindy uses when it runs shell commands and code. Its only documented scoping is visibility: a key is private to you or shared with the workspace. Nothing shows Lindy issuing scoped or least-privilege credentials for an agent. Guardrails govern which actions need approval, which is an adjacent control rather than credential scoping, and any scoping done at the third-party provider would be a user-side workaround.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
